title: Local migration supported-mode contract baseline

migrationRecords.compatibilityWindow: The hosted wire contracts and hosted-baseline mode remain supported while local-identity-preview is added; existing main-line user data is intentionally outside the compatibility window.
migrationRecords.migrationGuidance: Stop old main-line binaries, accept the destructive fresh-data identity migration, and select either the retained hosted composition or the explicit non-listening local identity preview. Future verified providers implement the shared provider, issuer, and subject assertion instead of adding an email-link path.
migrationRecords.rollback: Before merge, abandon or revert the Step 03 branch to the Step 02 base. After merge, stop Step 03 binaries, revert code and schema to a Step 02-compatible revision, and discard or recreate all Step 03 main-line data; no in-place data downgrade is promised. The preserved hosted-v1-maintenance line is unchanged.

additiveReplacement.description: A provider-neutral exact external-identity key and explicit local-identity-preview mode replace the removed Auth0 profile-copy and backend SDK-client dependencies.
